title: Route Apple HTTP sessions through a deliberate proxy
goal: Configure native Apple HTTP sessions per destination/proxy policy and keep CONNECT proxy credentials separate from origin authentication.

selectionNotes: Comparisons preserve the eight .NET10 foundations; no older route added.

prerequisites: GA composition: workload set 11.0.100.1 (Microsoft.NET.Workloads.11.0.100/11.100.1), Android 37.2.31, Apple 27.2.11039 and MAUI 11.0.0. Use JDK21 or25 and the selected Android SDK API37/build tools; Gradle9.1+ when invoked with JDK25. Apple requires Xcode27.2 on macOS Tahoe26.6+; the upstream Apple release says16.6+, conflicting with Apple host requirements. Binding SDK versions are not deployment floors.
